additive.title: Ihe mgbakwunye na ihe na-enye agba
additive.lead: Ihe na-enye agba na ihe na-eme ka glaze ghara ịdị ọcha anya (opacifier) a na-atụ n'elu usoro isi, dịka cobalt ma ọ bụ tin oxide. Usoro nwere ike ịhapụ ha na unity formula ma ọ bụ gụnye ha n'ime ya.
additive.newHeading: Tinye ihe mgbakwunye ma ọ bụ ihe na-enye agba
additive.name: Aha
additive.noChemistry: O nweghị nyocha oxide, dịka stain a na-ere n'ahịa: hapụ ya na unity formula
additive.firedNote: Dee ihe ọ na-enye glaze mgbe a gbachara ya ọkụ: cobalt oxide ojii, {asSold}, bụ {fired} nwere LOI {loi}%. Usoro nwere ike gụnye ya na unity formula.
